definitions.full: H1735. Dodavahu דּוֺדָוָהוּ proper name, masculine (< ᵐ5 τοῦ Ὠδεια ᵐ5 L Δουδιου , i.e. דּוֺדִיָּהוּ , beloved of ׳י , compare Nes Eg 70 ) father of Eliezer 2Chr 20:37 .
